title: actup configuration
description: Configuration file for actup, the GitHub Actions upgrader.

major.description: Global default target major version to upgrade actions to (e.g., 4).

sha.description: Write action refs as full commit SHAs with the tag in a trailing comment (e.g. '@<sha> # v4'). Existing SHA-pinned refs stay pinned.

actions.description: Per-action configuration mapping action names (e.g., 'actions/checkout') to specific versions or behaviors.

anyOf.description: Target major version (e.g., "4"), exact version (e.g., "v4.1.2", "master"), or "skip" to ignore this action.

pins.description: User-authored version constraints. When present, the manifest is managed: exact entries in 'actions' are recorded workflow state, while constraints (major number, exact ref, or "skip") live here.

anyOf.description: Target major version (e.g., "4"), exact version (e.g., "v4.1.2", "master"), or "skip" to ignore this action.

groups.description: Named action-glob groups selectable with actup --group <name>.
